verdict.rationale: Turso markets "Data residency you control" with bring-your-own-cloud deployment, and the durability docs say Pro and Enterprise customers can use their own S3 buckets so data stays inside their infrastructure. Local databases that run entirely in-process also keep data on the user's device. However, residency control is gated to paid tiers, and the evidence does not document choosing a cloud region when creating a database. Missing for 10: documented region selection at database creation, a list of available regions or residency guarantees, residency control on lower tiers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
